permission.denied: The app is not allowed to do this ({permission}).

storage.too_large: The app tried to store more than it may keep. The limit is {maxKb} KB.

account.disabled: This account is deactivated. Ask an administrator to activate it again.

challenge.expired: The sign-in step has expired. Please sign in again.

credentials.invalid: The user name or password is incorrect.

csrf.header_missing: The request was rejected because a security header is missing.

display_name.invalid: The display name can have at most {maxLength} characters and no control characters.

password.too_common: This password is too well known. Choose one that is harder to guess.
password.too_long: The password can have at most {maxLength} characters.
password.too_short: The password needs at least {minLength} characters.

permission.denied: You do not have permission for this action.

rate.limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {retryAfterSeconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

recovery.invalid: The user name or recovery key is incorrect.

session.expired: The session has expired. Please sign in again.

setup.already_done: This system has already been set up.

totp.invalid: The code is incorrect or has already been used.
totp.not_enrolled: Two-factor authentication has not been set up yet.

username.invalid: User names start with a lowercase letter or an underscore and contain only lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, at most 32 characters.
username.reserved: The user name {username} is reserved for the system.

device.not_found: No saved desktop was found for that device. It may have expired.

item.conflict: This desktop item was changed on another device in the meantime.
item.invalid: The desktop item could not be saved because it is not in a known format.
item.limit_reached: The desktop is full. It holds at most {max} items.
item.not_found: This desktop item no longer exists. It may have been deleted on another device.

layout.conflict: The desktop layout was saved from another tab in the meantime.
layout.invalid: The desktop layout could not be saved because it is not in a known format.
layout.too_large: The desktop layout is too large to save. At most {maxWindows} windows and {maxAppDataKb} KB of app data are kept.

note.too_long: The note is too long. A note holds at most {maxLength} characters.

cursor.invalid: The list position is no longer valid. Load the folder again.

entry.access_denied: The system does not allow access to this item.
entry.is_folder: This is a folder, not a file.
entry.not_folder: This is a file, not a folder.
entry.not_found: The file or folder was not found. It may have been moved or deleted.

io.failed: The file system reported an error (errno {errno}).

name.invalid: This name cannot be used. Names must not be empty, contain a slash, or be longer than 255 bytes.

operation.into_itself: A folder cannot be copied or moved into itself.
operation.invalid: This file operation is not valid.

path.invalid: This path is not valid. Paths are relative to the share, without “.” or “..”, and at most {maxBytes} bytes long.

range.not_satisfiable: The requested part of the file does not exist.

share.data_choice_required: Choose what happens with the data: keep it, or delete it for good.
share.dataset_name_invalid: No dataset name can be made from “{name}”. Use at least one letter from a to z or a digit.
share.description_invalid: The description can have at most {max} characters and no line breaks.
share.exists: A share with this name already exists.
share.folder_dev_only: Existing folders can only be registered as shares on a development machine. Create a shared folder instead; it gets its own dataset.
share.invalid: The share could not be created. It needs a name and an existing folder outside the system directories.
share.name_mismatch: The typed name does not match. Type {name} exactly.
share.name_reserved: The name {name} is used by Pithyx itself. Choose another name.
share.no_dataset: This shared folder is a plain folder, not a dataset. Its files can only be kept.
share.not_found: The share was not found, or you have no access to it.
share.path_taken: Something else is already mounted at {path}. Choose another name.
share.pool_not_prepared: The pool {pool} has no place for shared folders (pithyx/shares), so none can be created on it.
share.read_only: You can only read in this share.
share.unavailable: {name} cannot be opened right now: {reason, select, pool_missing {its pool is not connected} pool_unavailable {its pool stopped because disks are missing} other {its folder is not mounted}}. It comes back on its own once its disks are back.

thumbnail.not_found: There is no preview of this file yet.
thumbnail.too_many: Ask for at most {max} previews at once.

trash.retention_invalid: The recycle bin keeps items between 0 and {max} days (0 keeps them until it is emptied).

upload.incomplete: The upload was interrupted. Nothing was saved.

version.not_found: This version is no longer there. The snapshot may have been deleted; reload the list.

volume.full: There is not enough free space.

job.not_found: This job does not exist or has already been removed.

app.invalid: The app id {app} is not valid.

archive.pool_unavailable: The pool {pool} cannot hold the log archive now. It may be missing, locked or read-only.

batch.too_large: An app can send at most {max} log entries at once.

query.invalid: The log filter is not valid. Check the time range.

message.invalid: The notification was not sent: its {field, select, app {app id is not valid} title {title is empty or longer than {maxLength} characters} other {text is longer than {maxLength} characters}}.
The live connection received a message it does not understand.

topic.invalid: {topic} is not a valid topic name or pattern.
topic.unknown: There is no live data topic named {topic}.

upgrade.required: This address only accepts WebSocket connections.

media_type.unsupported: The request uses a content type the server does not accept.

method.not_allowed: This API endpoint does not support the request method.

route.not_found: This API endpoint does not exist.

method.unknown: This version of Pithyx does not support what the app asked for ({method}).

protocol.unsupported: This app needs another version of Pithyx (protocol {protocol}, supported {min} to {max}).

request.invalid: The app sent a request the desktop cannot process ({method}).
request.timeout: The desktop did not answer the app in time ({method}).

transport.closed: The connection between the app and the desktop is closed. Open the app again.

alert.not_found: This alert is no longer active. Its cause is gone.

command.failed: The storage command {command} failed (exit code {exitCode}). Nothing after it was run; the log has the details.
command.timed_out: {command} did not finish within {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. A disk of the pool probably stopped answering and ZFS is waiting for it. Check the disks in Storage. If other pools stop responding too, restart the box.

dataset.compression_invalid: Pithyx does not set the compression {compression}. Choose off, lz4, zle, zstd (levels 1 to 19) or gzip (levels 1 to 9).
dataset.in_use_by_share: The share {share} has its folder in {dataset}. Delete the share on the shared folders page first; there you choose what happens to its data.
dataset.limit_invalid: {property, select, quota {The quota} other {The reservation}} cannot be negative. Use 0 for none.
dataset.managed: Pithyx finds {dataset} by its name (a home folder, an app or system data), so it cannot be renamed or deleted here.
dataset.name_invalid: Dataset names use letters, digits, ., - and _, start with a letter or digit and have up to 64 characters.
dataset.name_mismatch: Type the full dataset name {name} exactly to confirm.
dataset.not_found: There is no dataset named {dataset}. Reload the page.
dataset.property_unsupported: {dataset} does not take the setting {property}. Volumes, the pool root and the datasets of the Pithyx layout take only compression, and record size is for file systems only.
dataset.protected: {dataset} is the pool root or part of the Pithyx layout. Pithyx does not rename or delete it.
dataset.quota_below_used: The quota must be at least the space the dataset uses now, snapshots and child datasets included.
dataset.record_size_invalid: The record size must be a power of two from 4 KiB to 1 MiB.
dataset.reservation_too_large: The pool cannot reserve that much for this dataset now. Choose a smaller reservation.
dataset.unchanged: Nothing to change: {dataset} has these settings already.

disk.not_found: The disk is no longer there. Reload the list and choose again.
disk.refused: The disk may not be used: {reason, select, system_disk {it holds the system} mounted {a file system on it is in use} pool_member {it belongs to a pool} not_test_disk {it is not a declared test disk} other {it is not safe to use}}.

encryption.unavailable: Encryption comes with the key vault in the next update. A pool can only be encrypted when it is created, so create it without encryption only if that is fine for its data.

plan.expired: This plan is more than 10 minutes old. Show it again to check the disks once more.
plan.not_found: This plan is no longer there (it ran already, expired or the daemon restarted). Show it again.
plan.stale: A disk changed after the plan was shown. Nothing was changed; show the plan again.

pool.disk_count: {layout} needs at least {min, plural, one {# disk} other {# disks}}; {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} selected.
pool.encryption_required: Answer the encryption question first: it can only be decided when the pool is created.
pool.name_invalid: Pool names start with a lowercase letter and use up to 32 lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Names like mirror or raidz are reserved.
pool.name_mismatch: Type the pool name {name} exactly to confirm.
pool.not_prepared: Pithyx did not set up the pool {pool} (it has no pithyx dataset), so it creates nothing on it.
pool.expanding: Pool {name} is being expanded already. The next disk can be added when that is done.
pool.read_only: Pool {name} is imported read-only and cannot be changed. Import it for use first.
pool.disks_missing: Disks of {name} are not connected, so it cannot be destroyed or exported now: the command would stop the pool and hang until the box restarts. Connect the disks again first, or restart the box to forget the pool.
pool.suspended: {name} has stopped all reads and writes because too many of its disks are gone. Destroying or exporting it now would hang until the box restarts. Connect the disks again; Pithyx then resumes the pool on its own.

schedule.invalid: This schedule cannot be set. Choose Off, Weekly or Monthly for an existing pool.

scrub.not_running: Pool {pool} is not being scrubbed right now.

snapshot.confirmation_mismatch: The name you typed does not match the dataset. Nothing was rolled back.
snapshot.dataset_not_found: There is no dataset named {dataset}. Reload the page.
snapshot.exists: A snapshot named {name} exists already. Wait a second and try again.
snapshot.held: The snapshot {name} is held and cannot be deleted. Release the hold first.
snapshot.newer_exist: The newer snapshots changed since the plan was shown: the dataset now has {count, plural, one {# newer snapshot} other {# newer snapshots}}. Nothing was rolled back; show the plan again.
snapshot.not_found: There is no snapshot named {name}. Reload the list.
snapshot.not_pithyx: Pithyx deletes only snapshots it took. {name} was made by someone else and stays.
snapshot.schedule_invalid: Each schedule is hourly, daily, weekly or monthly, once, and keeps between 1 and {max} snapshots.

vdev.not_found: The pool has no such device (any more). Reload and choose again.
vdev.not_raidz: Only a RAID-Z group can be expanded by a disk; {vdev} is not one.

volume.size_invalid: A volume needs a size of at least 1 MiB.
volume.too_large: The volume does not fit the free space of the pool. Make it smaller or create it as a sparse volume.

import.device_unknown: The device {device} of this pool is on no disk Pithyx knows, so it cannot check it. Nothing was imported.
import.force_required: Pool {name} was last used by another system. Import it only if that system no longer uses it: choose to force the import and type the pool name.
import.not_found: This pool is no longer found on the disks. Scan again.
import.not_importable: Pool {name} cannot be imported ({state}). Connect its missing disks and scan again.
import.preview_required: Import pool {name} read-only first and check its datasets, then import it for use.

zfs.unavailable: ZFS did not answer in time or reported an error, so Pithyx cannot show what this would change. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, a pool may be waiting for disks that are gone: see Storage.

internal.unexpected: Something went wrong on the server. The details are in the logs.

origin.forbidden: The request came from another website and was rejected.

time.apply_failed: The time setting could not be applied ({command} ended with exit code {exitCode}). The log has the details.
time.server_invalid: “{server}” is neither a host name nor an address.
time.zone_invalid: The system does not know the time zone “{zone}”.

account.refused: The Linux account {username} cannot be created ({reason}). A system account may already use this name.

uid.exhausted: No user ids are left. Every id from 20000 to 29999 has been given out once.

user.last_admin: The last administrator cannot be deleted or lose the administrator right.
user.not_found: The user was not found. Someone may have deleted it.
user.self: You cannot delete your own account.
